facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of CV-3102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on CV-3102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CV-3102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. CV-3102 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during shift handover while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 13 March 2016 a potential incident was recorded on CV-3102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
